face.name: 末日管弦家林恩
face.text: 嘲讽。亡语：双方玩家各抽两张牌，各弃两张牌，并各摧毁牌库顶的两张牌。
face.flavorText: 林恩是管弦界的绝顶。顶班的候补召唤就到，所以在这个团队里你必须尽力。

face.name: Rin, Orchestrator of Doom
face.text: Taunt. Deathrattle: Both players draw 2 cards, discard 2 cards, and destroy the top 2 cards of their deck.
face.flavorText: Rin's orchestra is the best of the best. When your replacement is just one summoning away, you have to play perfectly.

face.name: 菲里克·飞刺
face.text: 战吼：消灭一个随从及其所有的复制（无论它们在哪）。
face.flavorText: 初级探险者搜寻着夜空，生怕看见她头顶的烛火！

face.name: Flik Skyshiv
face.text: Battlecry: Destroy a minion and all copies of it (wherever they are).
face.flavorText: Junior explorers scan the night sky in fear of her candle’s flame!

face.name: 提克特斯
face.text: 战吼：移除你的牌库顶的五张牌。腐蚀：改为对手的牌库。
face.flavorText: “奖券，卡牌……全都过！期！了！”

face.name: Tickatus
face.text: Battlecry: Remove the top 5 cards from your deck. Corrupt: Your opponent's deck instead.
face.flavorText: "These are all.... EXPIRED!"

face.name: 舞王坎格尔
face.text: 吸血。亡语：将本随从与你手牌中的一个随从互换，并使其获得吸血。
face.flavorText: 砰砰博士加入怪盗军团之后，坎格尔与砰砰实验室彻底割席，开始追求自己的真爱——迪斯科！！！

face.name: Kangor, Dancing King
face.text: Lifesteal Deathrattle: Swap this with a minion from your hand and give it Lifesteal.
face.flavorText: After Dr. Boom's involvement with the League of EVIL, Kangor cut ties with the Boomsday Labs and began pursuing his true passion - DISCO!!!

face.name: 音响工程师普兹克
face.text: 战吼：将两张3/3的机器人置入你对手的手牌。亡语：为你自己召唤这些机器人。
face.flavorText: “我留在地面上，演出过程中所有出问题的侏儒工程学设备都是我来修。菲兹尔那个小丑不过是在天上拍了几张照片。你说说，谁才是优秀的工程师！”

face.name: Pozzik, Audio Engineer
face.text: Battlecry: Add two 3/3 Bots to your opponent's hand. Deathrattle: Summon them for yourself.
face.flavorText: "I'm down here, fixin' all the Gnomish tech that breaks down mid-set while that buffoon Fizzle is up there taking pictures of the sky. YOU tell ME who's the better engineer!"

face.name: 蜡烛巨龙
face.text: 亡语：将一支蜡烛洗入你的牌库。抽到蜡烛时，重新召唤蜡烛巨龙。
face.flavorText: 蜡烛巨龙，为王而战。翻过原野，万物焦烂！

face.name: Waxadred
face.text: Deathrattle: Shuffle a Candle into your deck that resummons Waxadred when drawn.
face.flavorText: Waxadred the dragon fought for his king, frolicking through the fields melting everything!

face.name: 曼科里克
face.text: 战吼：帮助曼科里克寻找他的妻子！她曾出现在你牌库中的某个地方。
face.flavorText: 玩家每创建一个部落角色，他的噩梦便会重演一遍。

face.name: Mankrik
face.text: Battlecry: Help Mankrik find his wife! She was last seen somewhere in your deck.
face.flavorText: Relives his nightmare every day a new Horde player is created.

face.name: 爆破之王砰砰
face.text: 战吼：你对手的牌库中每有一张“炸弹”牌，便召唤两个1/1的砰砰机器人。
face.flavorText: 给他一点添加剂，他可以飞越整片天空。

face.name: Blastmaster Boom
face.text: Battlecry: Summon two 1/1 Boom Bots for each Bomb in your opponent's deck.
face.flavorText: He's gonna fly through the air with the greatest of grease.

face.name: 玛克希玛·雷管
face.text: 战吼：从你的牌库中召唤一个随从，使其攻击敌方英雄，然后死亡。
face.flavorText: 信不信由你，这个游戏在马戏团的玩命排行榜中仅列第四位。

face.name: Maxima Blastenheimer
face.text: Battlecry: Summon a minion from your deck. It attacks the enemy hero, then dies.
face.flavorText: Believe it or not, this is only the faire's fourth most dangerous game.

face.name: 巴琳达·斯通赫尔斯
face.text: 战吼：抽两张法术牌，使其法力值消耗与本随从的属性值交换。
face.flavorText: 石炉哨站的首领绝对想不到自己有朝一日会加入一款叫炉石的游戏。

face.name: Balinda Stonehearth
face.text: Battlecry: Draw 2 spells. Swap their Costs with this minion's stats.
face.flavorText: Imagine her surprise, ending up in a game called Hearthstone.

Explicit parent primary childIds prove exact6new+1old child identities. Full732 past candidates and all original source roles/order retained.

Lynn has actual Taunt. Its native Deathrattle performs actual own/opponent Draw2, then ordinary own/opponent random Discard2, then original own/opponent top-deck Destroy2. Each later original stage is accepted after earlier reactions; normal fatigue, cast-when-drawn, discard/deck-destruction native bodies and death pipeline remain shared. Exact simultaneous/CN ordering is deferred, not a second draw/discard/destruction executor.

Flik uses the targeted current minion name, including current display-name overrides and frozen CN raw-name lookup across all known source Minions, without filtering to implemented faces. Same-name variants/Core forms/Jades/Treants are not reduced to equal card_id or one metadata deck_identity. Full raw source name index is a structural predicate, not completion or a generation pool. All original live same-name boards and physical hand/deck Minions are captured once; ordinary board DestroyBatch plus DestroyStoredCard preserve actual zone distinctions, no graveyard resurrection/destruction or later same-name new acquisition rebind. Dormancy and precise cross-zone death checkpoint ordering remain local contract.

Tickatus real Corrupt hand progress upgrades to exact DMF_118t through original strict higher paid quotes and ordinary hand lifecycle; base destroys own current top5, corrupted destroys opponent current top5. The original stored deck-destruction path interprets remove-from-deck as milling, not a board death, discard or arbitrary SETASIDE poof. Count5 is exact; no duplicate10-card bug. This milling classification and exact CN Sludge/native destroyed-body interaction are recorded local policy pending confirmation; local actual destroyed-body checks do not claim official calibration.

Kangor actual Deathrattle invokes original physical swap machinery with an exact HAND inventory. Source normal death/early activation, actual original invocation, board slot and net hand slot remain bound. Incoming original leaves hand before outgoing source returns; full hand/full board swaps do not burn a net-slot original. Both original writes commit before entry/return observers, old reverse reset applies to outgoing; ordinary actual recruit callbacks grant Lifesteal to original delivery and legitimate quantity extras. Empty eligible hand consumes no RNG and does not return source. Original deck-swap default and payload fields remain, with one last zone=DECK field; only exact HAND extension is new.

Pozzik creates two actual3/3 Audio Bots through original hand creation and binds successful original HandEntryRecord IDs into original hand_selection native memory before either creation notification. Burned cards have no hand acquisition and cannot become summon rewards; listeners cannot observe an unbound gift. Actual native Deathrattle follows those same original physical IDs only while their current face is the real Bot and current zone is HAND or DECK, then uses ordinary cross-controller stored summon. Played, transformed, burned or destroyed Bots and unrelated same-name new copies are excluded; bounced original Bots may qualify again under this local identity policy. Source silence/reset/copy/control uses existing native memory lifecycle. Opposing-deck eligibility follows public player notes; exact control-transfer/bounce/repeat CN edges deferred.

Waxadred shuffles exact original Candle with one semantic shuffle. Candle casts when drawn and summons a fresh printed Waxadred through ordinary SummonByCard, not a new Battlecry or a new copy executor; replacement draw uses original shared draw-cast chain. Mankrik shuffles exact Olgra/63593; its actual draw CAST summons exact3/7 enraged Mankrik/63594 and original actual recipient ForceAttacks enemy hero before ordinary completion. Explicit source-primary childIds prove both names; no guessed prefix dependency closure.

Blastmaster counts each current physical BOT_511t/48752 Bomb in opponent deck, not own cards, hand or arbitrary same-name adventure Bomb; exact root primary lists Bomb and original GVG_110t/2235 Boom Bot. Two ordinary new Boom Bots per original count use existing summon capacity and original complete Boom Bot Deathrattle, no new pool or blank token. Bomb actual draw-cast deals ordinary5SPELL damage to its actual caster hero and runs shared replacement/fatigue, Spell Damage and health-source policies; precise CN modifiers remain subject to ordinary calibration.

Maxima uses original random physical own-deck recruit and its original attributed successful-recipient callback; original body ForceAttacks enemy hero, then is destroyed through its captured original residence. No target substitution, stale same-ID rebind, new Battlecry, fake attack or duplicate recruit implementation. Empty/full-board/ordinary death and quantity behavior remain shared.

Balinda adds only exact source_spell_cost_stats reward to the original two-Spell DrawPhysicalGroup. Original source presence and both full captured root Spell materials survive waits; first root price exchanges with Attack, second with remaining Health. Surviving actual original hand Spells use full current ordinary quote before any swap writes; ordinary cost modifiers and captured stat setter perform writes. Burned/draw-cast roots keep their frozen pre-draw local price for source stats, but never discount a replacement card. Lost source skips swaps while original draws still complete. One missing Spell only changes first stat, empty matching pool does not fatigue. No complete formal pool/Standard/CN claim. Fixed version/hotfix alignment and CN rule edges remain deferred; MIS_701, YOG_522 and all six original domains stay open. Data/definition presence and local validation do not substitute for original source binding or official support.
